newsitem.title: POLAND: Universal approves convertible bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Universal approves convertible bond issue.

text.p: Shareholders of Polish trading firm Universal SA have approved a convertible bond issue of 1,000 bonds worth a total of 100 million zlotys, a spokeswoman for the company said on Thursday.
Anna Korneluk told Reuters that the firm would issue the bonds with a semi-annual 5.5-percent coupon in a private placement to no more than 300 selected investors.

She said the bonds, for which the firm would issue no more than 10 million new shares, would be convertible into 10,000 new common shares each with a par value of five zlotys each between April 1, 1997, and December 21, 2001.
The firm had previoulsy planned to offer 810 five-year, 12 percent convertible bonds with a face value of 100,000 zlotys.
